style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Christmas Woodland Foliage Wreath
style.toneOfVoice: Bring the serene beauty of the forest into your home with this 60cm woodland greens wreath. Expertly crafted with a lush mix of lifelike foliage, this artificial wreath captures the rich textures and deep green hues of woodland greenery, creating a timeless and natural decorative accent. Perfect for hanging on doors, walls, or using as a table centrepiece, its full, balanced design adds depth and visual interest to any space. The realistic leaves and layered construction provide a fresh, vibrant look without any maintenance, making it ideal for year-round display. Measuring 60cm in diameter, this woodland greens wreath is maintenance-free, staying beautiful season after season. It’s an effortless way to bring a touch of understated elegance to your home décor. Bring indoors during adverse weather conditions. Wreath Width: W60cm. Wipe clean with a soft cloth.
